# TopStoriesWebsites.com

> The definitive global marketplace and brokerage platform for verified Google News, Google Discover, Google Top Stories, Bing News, and Yahoo News media properties.

TopStoriesWebsites.com is an institutional digital media asset brokerage headquartered at 100 Wall Street, 24th Floor, New York, NY 10005. Managed by senior media economists, enterprise CMS engineers, and M&A brokers, the platform facilitates safe acquisitions of algorithmically approved news publishing entities. Every asset listed on the exchange undergoes a mandatory 5-point forensic audit.

## Corporate Identity & E-E-A-T Authority
- [About Us & Leadership Board](https://topstorieswebsites.com/about/): Executive profiles of Managing Partner David Sterling, Head of Algorithmic Due Diligence Marcus Vance (Columbia University alumnus), and Compliance Lead Elena Rostova.
- [100% Escrow Guarantee](https://topstorieswebsites.com/escrow-guarantee/): Comprehensive buyer safeguards, mandatory 7-day technical inspection periods, and licensed escrow custody via Escrow.com (California DFPI licensed).
- [5-Point Verification Standards](https://topstorieswebsites.com/editorial-standards/): Forensic criteria for Google Publisher Center status, sub-90s indexing benchmarks, GSC manual action reviews, and backlink topology analysis.
- [Contact Corporate Desk](https://topstorieswebsites.com/contact/): Physical address (100 Wall Street, NYC), direct phone line (+1-212-555-0198), and PGP encrypted acquisition desk.
- [Privacy Policy](https://topstorieswebsites.com/privacy/): GDPR & CCPA compliant data handling and non-disclosure standards.
- [Terms of Service](https://topstorieswebsites.com/terms/): Legally binding digital Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and marketplace regulations.

## Core Services & Marketplace Inventory
- [Google News Websites For Sale](https://topstorieswebsites.com/marketplace/google-news-sites-for-sale/): Verified publishing domains featuring active Google Publisher Center status, high-velocity article indexing (60 to 180 seconds avg), and clean editorial histories.
- [Buy Top Stories Websites](https://topstorieswebsites.com/marketplace/top-stories-eligible-websites/): High-authority media properties pre-audited for consistent placement in Google SERP Top Stories breaking news carousels.
- [Buy Google Discover Featuring Websites](https://topstorieswebsites.com/marketplace/google-discover-websites/): Digital news publications with proven algorithmic interest feed reach, generating high-RPM passive mobile traffic across US, UK, and CA audiences.
- [Bing Approved Sites for Sale](https://topstorieswebsites.com/marketplace/bing-news-approved-sites/): Verified Bing Webmaster PubHub publishers with native IndexNow automated protocol and Windows 11 desktop widget feed distribution.
- [Yahoo News Sites for Sale](https://topstorieswebsites.com/marketplace/yahoo-news-network-sites/): High-authority media assets with active partner feed syndication into Yahoo News, Yahoo Finance, and MSN.

## Interactive Tools & Resources
- [Google News Website Valuation Calculator](https://topstorieswebsites.com/tools/google-news-site-valuation-calculator/): Proprietary multiple calculator calculating accurate market values for news publishing properties based on net profit, Discover traffic percentage, and domain authority.
- [Google News Approval Checker](https://topstorieswebsites.com/tools/google-news-approval-check/): Multi-point diagnostic tool verifying live Publisher Center inclusion, Google News tab indexing, and schema validity.
- [News Publishing Authority Vault](https://topstorieswebsites.com/knowledge-base/): Comprehensive technical and editorial guides on news algorithms, Core Web Vitals, entity salience, and monetization strategies.
